review_context: Generated run-root to checked read-only UI demo fixture promotion for synthetic QA evidence.
finding_title: Generated run promotion must be allowlisted and sanitized before checked UI fixture use.
finding_summary: A generated QA run root can contain valid review artifacts, stale wrappers, temporary outputs, nested duplicates, or local absolute paths. Checked frontend fixtures should be promoted only through a static allowlist, recursive run-root sanitizer, fail-closed side-effect checks, and Rust boundary/hash/snapshot gates.
observable_context: The read-only UI imports checked JSON fixtures from apps/legal-intake-budget/src/fixtures.
The wrapper refresh command updates source hashes and manifest inventory, but does not decide which generated run-root artifacts should become checked fixtures.
Generated run roots can include missing, ambiguous, nested, or noisy JSON files that should not be copied into the frontend fixture set.

The new promote-ui-demo-run-fixtures command blocks without --write-fixtures, promotes only allowlisted reports, rewrites generated run-root strings to <demo-run-root>, and verifies the result with Rust boundary, source-hash, and snapshot-coherence gates.
observable_decision_logic: Static fixture promotion prevents arbitrary generated JSON from becoming frontend truth.
Recursive JSON sanitization preserves structured fields while removing local run-root paths from checked artifacts.
Missing, ambiguous, out-of-root, leaking, or side-effecting artifacts must block before any fixture mutation.
Rust gates should verify the promoted fixture set because source-hash and snapshot drift are deterministic leaf checks.
Wrapper refresh and generated-run promotion are different exception classes and should remain separately visible to DAD.
solution_path: Use a static allowlist for UI-imported semantic detail reports plus generated wrapper reports.
Reject missing, ambiguous, path-traversal, run-root-leaking, or prohibited side-effect artifacts before mutation.
Back up checked fixture JSON before mutation and roll back on downstream gate failure.
Regenerate the checked Rust fixture-boundary report, refresh UI wrapper hashes and manifest, then require Rust gates to pass.
Add focused tests for no-write guard, successful sanitization, missing source, ambiguous source, out-of-root source ref, side-effect rejection, and unallowlisted JSON exclusion.
applies_when: A generated local QA run root is being considered for checked frontend demo fixtures.
A frontend fixture set must display synthetic QA evidence without leaking local run-root paths.
A repo needs to distinguish wrapper freshness from semantic artifact promotion.
does_not_apply_when: The UI wrapper hashes alone are stale but semantic detail reports are unchanged.
A production runtime artifact registry already owns fixture publication.
Real client, matter, privileged, negotiated-rate, connector, or carrier-portal data is present.
danger_if_misapplied: If a generated run root is directory-copied into checked fixtures, stale or noisy JSON can become UI evidence, local paths can leak into committed files, and DAD may mistake wrapper freshness for semantic artifact review.
suggested_actions: DAD should classify generated-run promotion separately from wrapper refresh and source-hash drift.
Exception Lake design should preserve missing-source, ambiguous-source, side-effect-blocked, sanitizer-leak, and Rust-gate-failed labels as distinct candidate classes.
Future agents should use a static allowlist and recursive sanitizer before turning generated outputs into checked assets.
reviewer_notes: This record describes synthetic fixture and local artifact promotion only.
It records observable evidence, assumptions, decision logic, fix refs, and test refs without hidden chain-of-thought.
red_team_notes: Do not treat promotion as production approval, budget approval, Lake admission, or learning.
Do not infer promotion coverage from arbitrary run-root files.
Do not promote local candidate schemas to Semantic Substrate canon from this repo.
